scientific_limits: Human assessed-usefulness is an indirect proxy, not observed time saved or conflict prevention. Synthetic sequence and hash-chain checks cover the supplied fixture only; hashes are not signatures and do not establish source authenticity or upstream completeness. A three-family holdout supports description only; incomplete labels and source scarcity may make the comparison inconclusive. Finite corpus and shared producer/verifier replay engine do not prove general OT, contextual equivalence, confluence, Yang-Baxter, production performance or safe parallel execution. Prospective sidecar and filtered lab checks exercise local software only; actor identity, independent outside observations, upstream completeness and natural production yield remain unproven.
